## Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations 2014

### Liquidity and Capital Resources - Factors Affecting Sources of Liquidity

During the year ended December 31, 2005, we issued an aggregate of 4,670,335 shares of our Class A common stock upon conversion of $57.1 million principal amount of our 3.25% (3.25%) notes. Pursuant to the terms of the indenture, the holders of the 3.25% (3.25%) notes received 81.808 shares of Class A common stock for every $1,000 principal amount of notes converted.
